summary: Phases 1-5 are substantially implemented and well-structured. Phase 6 (integration tests) is entirely missing — the coder stalled during test writing and never proposed. The implementation covers 15 files with 1330 insertions / 1015 deletions across the egg_restrictions shared package, per-agent worktree isolation, per-agent git identity, SDK tool interception, and auto-commit removal. However, the contract plan requires 24 tasks including Phase 6 integration tests and docs, and the missing tests represent a significant gap.

phase_1_extract_restrictions.detail: shared/egg_restrictions/ package created with patterns.py (651 lines, all 16 agent roles), checker.py (118 lines, AgentRestrictionResult + validation functions), and __init__.py with clean re-exports. gateway/agent_restrictions.py refactored to re-export from shared package (backward compatible). shared/pyproject.toml updated to include egg_restrictions*.

phase_2_per_agent_worktree.detail: container_spawner.py creates per-agent worktrees with ID '{pipeline_id}-{role}' at spawn time, falling back to shared volumes on failure. CONTAINER_ID env var is now per-agent. orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py updated to clarify orchestrator-side vs agent-side worktrees. worktree_manager.py adds list_worktrees_for_pipeline(), cleanup_clean_worktree(), and cleanup_stale_pipeline_worktrees(). Pipeline cleanup in container_spawner.py now cleans per-agent worktrees.

phase_3_per_agent_git_identity.detail: sandbox/entrypoint.py reads EGG_AGENT_ROLE and sets git user.name to 'egg (<role>)' and user.email to '<role>@egg.local'. Falls back to 'egg' / 'egg@localhost' when no role is set. Log message updated to reflect dynamic identity.

phase_4_sdk_tool_interception.detail: shared/egg_agent/tool_interceptor.py (137 lines) implements check_file_write_permission() for Write/Edit/NotebookEdit tools. Properly normalizes repo-relative paths and includes _find_owning_role() for helpful error messages. client.py integrates via intercept_tools parameter. However, interception only LOGS warnings — it does not actually block the tool call. This is warn-only soft enforcement. The plan may have intended hard blocking at the SDK level.

phase_5_remove_auto_commit.detail: gateway/post_agent_commit.py auto_commit_worktree() is now a logged no-op. All complex auto-commit/push/phase-filter/salvage-branch logic removed (~240 lines deleted). Module docstring updated. detect_uncommitted_changes() added to container_spawner.py to support future HITL recovery. gateway/git_client.py updated with per-agent worktree scoping comment.

phase_6_integration_tests.detail: No integration tests were committed. The coder's last progress event showed 'Phase 6: writing integration tests' at 07:51:13 UTC but the coder stalled and never pushed test code. Zero test files in the diff. This is a significant gap — the new egg_restrictions package, worktree lifecycle, and tool interceptor have no test coverage in this PR.

behavioral_changes.change: Unknown agent roles now get deny-by-default (returns False) instead of fail-open (returned True). This is a security improvement but changes observable behavior.
behavioral_changes.recommendation: Verify existing agents with non-standard roles won't be blocked. The gateway's old code allowed unknown roles — the new shared code denies them.

behavioral_changes.change: Tool interception logs warnings but does not block Write/Edit/NotebookEdit calls that violate role restrictions. This is warn-only, not hard enforcement.
behavioral_changes.recommendation: Acceptable for gradual rollout, but the plan may have intended hard blocking. Consider adding a flag or follow-up to enable blocking mode.

The egg_restrictions shared package has no unit tests
The worktree lifecycle changes (create/cleanup/detect) have no tests
The tool interceptor has no tests
Coder did not send CONSENSUS_PROPOSE — stalled during Phase 6
positive_observations: Clean extraction of 770+ lines from gateway/agent_restrictions.py to shared/egg_restrictions/ with backward-compatible re-exports
Per-agent worktree isolation design is sound: {pipeline_id}-{role} naming, graceful fallback to shared volumes on failure
Auto-commit removal is clean and well-documented — preserves the function signature for backward compat while making it a no-op
Tool interceptor provides helpful error messages including which role owns the target file
Deny-by-default for unknown agent roles is a security improvement
Code quality is high: type hints, docstrings, security comments, structured logging
